skills.title: Bombing
skills.description: Bomber damage to ship units +50%

skills.title: Air-Defense
skills.description: Air defense device equipped on warships

skills.title: Carrier
skills.description: Able to attack by aircraft

skills.title: Aerial Hunter
skills.description: Launches a "Granit" missile at the target, dealing 100% missile damage to the target and 50% splash damage to targets within 1 tile of it. Also applies the "Fire Control Interference" effect. Cooldown of 1 turn.

skills.title: Sustained Pursuit
skills.description: After a carrier-based aircraft defeats a target, it has a {0}% chance to attack again. Increases the critical damage of the next carrier-based aircraft attack by 20%, stacking up to 2 times. Lasts for 1 turn.

skills.title: Counter-Intercept
skills.description: Increases damage dealt by carrier-based aircraft by 15%. When any allied ship within 3 tiles of the carrier is attacked by an enemy, there is a {0}% chance to immediately launch Counter-Intercept for one time, dealing carrier-based aircraft attack damage to the original attacker (which will not deal critical damage).
